scenes.text: (breath)一棵大树没有心脏，却能把水送到几十米高的树梢。
en: A tall tree has no heart,
yet it lifts water dozens of meters up to its crown.

scenes.text: 水从根部进来，沿着树干里的细管往上走。
en: Water comes in through the roots,
and climbs thin tubes inside the trunk.

scenes.text: 动力来自叶子：叶片背面有很多气孔，水从这里变成水汽散出去。
en: The pull comes from the leaves:
their undersides are full of tiny pores,

scenes.text: 叶子散掉一点水，细管里的水就被往上拉一点，像用吸管喝水。
en: Each time a leaf loses a little water,
the water in the tubes is pulled up a little,

scenes.text: 中午阳光最强，叶子散水最多，树喝水也最快。
en: At noon the sun is strongest,
the leaves lose the most water,

scenes.text: 树喝水，靠的是叶子在上面拉。
en: because its leaves pull from above.
